_comment: Venue website + closure decisions that override SERP discovery. SERP is unreliable for closed restaurants (dead domains, lookalikes, directory pages), so a human answer here is final: 'website' is used directly and never re-resolved, and 'closed' suppresses discovery entirely. Keys are norm() of the venue name (lowercase alphanumerics only).

broken_tls_chain.commis: Serves a DigiCert GeoTrust leaf with no intermediate, so a client with a full trust store fails with 'unable to verify the first certificate'. Browsers fetch the missing intermediate; requests does not. Confirmed live at 28KB naming Commis with a valid og:image.

booking_only.parallel37: Resy/SevenRooms page is the only live presence; the restaurant itself is closed.
